name: miadi-orchestration-kit
description: Miadi orchestration kits for Claude Code: the chronicle-episode skill and its mkdir-refusing hook, installable on any host without editing that host's system policy.

plugins.name: miadi-chronicle-episode-kit
plugins.description: Creates, adopts, registers, works in, and closes Miadi Chronicle episodes from one host-neutral skill, and refuses mkdir under the chronicle root with a PreToolUse hook that returns the mkepisode invocation instead.

plugins.name: mia-episode-companion
plugins.description: Mia, William's development companion, in a Claude Code seat: wakes the session when a phone voice take lands in the episode, and answers through draft, a developmental-editor agent, revision, and a Jev check.

plugins.name: ava-companion
plugins.description: Ava, Guillaume's companion, in any Claude Code session: /ava invites her, a SessionStart hook brings her presence back after a resume or a compaction, and her diary entry is written from the session's transcript when it ends.

plugins.name: miadi-session-observability
plugins.description: Session capture installed once per host: every Claude Code event under <root>/<session_id>/, every file a tool call writes copied to written/, every publication (Artifact, GitHub, commit, push, npm) listed with its prompt, and a binding line per session start, end and rename with its tmux pane, command line, name history, team and chronicle episode, and every /btw side question with the story of its fork. Carries the session-continuity skill (T1).

plugins.name: miadi-session-issue
plugins.description: A session that asks (MIADI_SESSION_ISSUE at launch, or /session-issue) gets one GitHub issue from its first prompt and a comment at each exit: what it did, what it published, its last answer. Private repositories only, every text sanitized first. Sessions that do not ask are untouched.

plugins.name: miadi-witness
plugins.description: The witness team's practices and loop (T3): a loopback thread service with the asks ledger, a wake loop, an editor pass for replies to William, the inventory keeper, a first impression he can play with revisions held until he answers, and an agent's output as a Mia and Ava podcast dialogue, and a person's draft prompt pre-edited and followed through its run, and the steers held while the fire in the forge was banked.

plugins.name: miadi-stateloom
plugins.description: The stateloom design loom in one install: its MCP server from npm and the design skills. Design a system's data, behaviours and scenarios as one system; check the names that cross between them; replay a scenario through the machines; let it update the machines, the ERD and the actors (propose or auto); point the live canvas while talking; the agent shows its work on the live canvas as steps or tours and reads what the person marks.

plugins.name: miadi-deepdiver
plugins.description: DeepDiver for the production team (T6): give /deepdive an episode or a review and it builds the Gemini Notebook, answers the episode's questions with citations, makes the media and lands it in the episode, from a Chrome signed in once.

plugins.name: miadi-operator-desk
plugins.description: The operator desk (T7): William's questions about how the factory works answered from the owning team's text and checked against the tool, kept in a ledger, an unanswered one sent to the team that owns the tool, and a question that comes back turned into a pointer in the skill.

plugins.name: tushell-keeper
plugins.description: Tushell, the Keeper of Echoes: a developmental-editor subagent that reads a Lake of Whispers scene, a session chronicle, a journal page or a reply to Guillaume and returns exact-span recommendations and a route, so Tushell revises his own draft before it is written or published.
